title: TRI-1 Euler — Trinity TRI-NET e-engine (8x2 SUPER-CROWN + 10 CLARA gaps + D2D holo mesh)
description: Open-source RTL for the TRI-1 Euler chip, the e-engine SKU of the Trinity TRI-NET sacred-constant triplet (phi-anchor / e-engine / gamma-surface). Submitted to Tiny Tapeout TTSKY26b on SKY130A. Includes 86+ synthesisable Verilog-2005 modules under src/, the GF16 inner-product engine, the d2d_holo_mesh stub, the BLAKE3 audit-receipt path, and 10 DARPA-CLARA-style AI safety gaps. This bundle is open RTL and open PDK only — no silicon has returned. All TOPS/W, NMSE, and bandwidth figures in the accompanying docs are explicitly PROJECTED / SPEC-DRAFT / SIMULATED per docs/VERIFICATION_CLAIMS_MATRIX.md.
notes: R5-HONEST disclosure. This bundle ships RTL + simulation + spec evidence only. TOPS/W (75 baseline, 405 boosted, 5.4x AVS-96 boost) are PROJECTED to a 22FDX-class node under stated assumptions per docs/PROJECTIONS_22FDX.md; the SKY130A demonstrator does not run at that envelope and no silicon measurement exists. GF16 vs bfloat16 NMSE is a SPEC-DRAFT protocol per docs/GF16_BFLOAT16_NMSE.md with a golden vector pack at tests/vectors/nmse/gf16_vs_bfloat16_v0.json; no NMSE number is quoted. The line-wide Trinity Stack DOI (10.5281/zenodo.19227877) is the only DOI cited in this repo. NO PER-REPO TTSKY26b ZENODO DOI HAS BEEN MINTED. This .zenodo.json describes the metadata that WILL accompany a future Zenodo deposition if and when one is uploaded; the act of merging this file does NOT mint a DOI.
